newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian share index steady in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian share index steady in dull trade.

text.p: The all-share index, the barometer of trading on the Nigerian stock exchange, closed little changed on Monday in flagging activity, traders said.
It closed at 8458.29, up from 8458.02 on Friday.
Dealers said trading was dull because of Nigeria's gloomy economic outlook and the over-pricing of many stocks.
"The market is forcing investors to adjust to realities," said Tunde Ayeni of CSL stockbrokers told Reuters.
Of nine equities that saw price movements on Monday, six issues closed lower.
Conglomerate John Holt, which posted lower half-year profit last week, was 10 kobo weaker at 9.50 naira followed by West African Portland Cement Company, which ended five kobo down at 62.20 naira.
National Salt Company of Nigeria also fell five kobo to 5.65 naira.
Afribank ended at 6.45 naira, down two kobo.
Nestle remained bullish, ending 10 kobo higher at 51.10 naira. Oil miller P.S. Mandrides also gained 10 kobo at 6.30 naira.
Conglomerate United Trading Company (UTC) rose one kobo at 1.43 naira.
